```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, out.width = "100%")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(tidyverse); library(gt)})
tb <- function(name, title = NULL, digits = 3) {
  df <- read_csv(file.path("tables", paste0(name, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
  g <- gt(df) |> fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = digits, drop_trailing_zeros = TRUE) |> tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
  if (!is.null(title)) g <- g |> tab_header(title = title)
  g
}
fg <- function(name) knitr::include_graphics(file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".png")))
```

# 1. Data

Twenty-two quarters (1Q21 to 2Q26) of KPIs, GAAP and cash cost lines, margins and cash flow from the Historicals workbook; 23 earnings prints with consensus, guidance and stock reaction from its Earnings sheet; the driver model's bear / base / bull quarterly and annual outputs, its 441-cell scenario grid and valuation summary; and 1,440 daily closes since the IPO. Every script reads the workbooks directly, so a rebuild of the model flows through on the next `source("run_all.R")`.
